')!important;
    filter:none!important;
    opacity:1!important;
    background-position:center top!important;
    background-size:cover!important;
  }
  /* Header is an opaque slate lockup, not a warm graphite panel. */
  .brand-banner.master-brand {
    background:linear-gradient(112deg,#1e2831 0%,#182129 63%,#171e25 100%)!important;
    border:1px solid #d4b78a24!important;
    box-shadow:0 18px 44px #060a0d35!important;
  }
  .brand-banner.master-brand .over {color:#d5b991!important;}
  .brand-banner.master-brand .hero-titles h1 {color:#f2ede4!important;}
  .brand-banner.master-brand .hero-right .signature {color:#d4dde5!important;}
  .brand-banner.master-brand .hero-right .signature strong {color:#f3e7d1!important;}
  .brand-banner.master-brand .hero-right .pill {
    background:#22322f!important;border-color:#426259!important;color:#c4e1d3!important;
  }

  /* MASTER 4.8.92.18 OUTER GLASS: #setup/#americano/#knockout .card  */
  .setup-card,.master-roster-card,.roster-registration-list,.p5-si-card,
  .card,.match-center,.leaderboard-card,.stage1-controls,
  .stage1-rules,.prepare-next,.stage2-summary,.stage3-summary,
  .final-verdict,.champion,.champion-card,.stage2-card,
  .team-duel-card,.decider-card,.match-history-card {
    background:var(--mc-surface)!important;
    border-color:var(--p5-glass-edge)!important;
    box-shadow:var(--p5-glass-shadow)!important;
    -webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(9px) saturate(110%)!important;
    backdrop-filter:blur(9px) saturate(110%)!important;
  }
  /* MASTER 4.8.92.18 INNER GLASS: scoring courts, stats and panels. */
  .club-board,.match-center .court,.court,.master-stats .stat,.stat,
  .prepare-row,.rounds-drawer,.round-fixture,.roster-group,
  .setup-current-format,.format-summary,.score-review,.duel-row,
  .waiting-court,.setup-info,.colors-advanced,.history-inline-editor,
  .roster-team-tabs,.roster-team-tab,.round-history-panel,
  .stage2-match,.stage3-match,.duel-match,.decider-match,
  .stage2-score-card,.stage3-score-card,
  .round-chip,.roster-pair-card {
    background:var(--mc-court)!important;
    border-color:rgba(206,190,169,.25)!important;
    box-shadow:var(--p5-glass-shadow)!important;
    -webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(10px) saturate(112%)!important;
    backdrop-filter:blur(10px) saturate(112%)!important;
  }
  /* Stats use the dedicated deeper master tint. */
  .master-stats .stat,.stat,.verdict-points .stat {
    background:var(--mc-stat)!important;
    border-color:rgba(206,190,169,.25)!important;
  }
  /* Court headings, live names, leaderboard and score are ivory/soft gold. */
  h2,h3,.setup-card h2,.match-center-head h2,.leaderboard-title,
  .club-name,.duel-title,.pairname,.ranked-pair-details strong {
    color:#f2ede4!important;
  }
